sections.description: Adds litigation settlements, specifically the Rules Relief Class settlement described in Note 19, as a source of future limitations on Mastercard's rules and business practices; the legal proceedings note cross-reference also moves from Note 21 to Note 19.

A.rationale: criterion 2: a new specific named proceeding (the Rules Relief Class settlement) is referenced as a source of business limitations; the Note 21 to Note 19 change alone would be a minor cross-reference update.

B.rationale: criterion 2: a new specific proceeding (the Rules Relief Class settlement) is referenced as a source of future rule or business-practice limitations; the note renumbering alone would be minor.

sections.description: Broadens the example technology from "cryptocurrency and blockchain" to "digital assets and blockchain" and adds that third parties Mastercard relies on for new technologies may fail to keep pace with changes "including with regard to AI", while trimming "safety and security technologies" to "security technologies".

A.rationale: criterion 1 and criterion 3: a newly specified dependency on third parties keeping pace with AI is disclosed, and replacing cryptocurrency with the broader category of digital assets widens the scope of the technology risk.

B.rationale: criterion 3: scope widened (cryptocurrency to the broader category of digital assets) and the third-party dependency risk is newly extended to AI specifically.
